headline: Helios Towers Raises 2027 Tenancy Outlook After Q3 Beat
summary: Helios Towers reported a Q3 earnings beat and subsequently raised its 2027 tenancy outlook.
why: Helios Towers operates telecommunications infrastructure in Africa and the Middle East. Tenancy growth is a key metric for the valuation of tower companies.

impacts.name: Helios Towers
impacts.why: Raising guidance is a strong positive signal for future earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Raising long-term guidance following a quarterly beat indicates strong operational momentum and confidence in future growth.
